name: Minecraft: BungeeCord
description: BungeeCord proxy for connecting multiple Minecraft servers.

files.config.yml:
listeners:
- query_port: {{PROXY_PORT}}
  motd: '{{MOTD}}'
  priorities:
  - lobby
  bind_local_address: true
  host: 0.0.0.0:{{PROXY_PORT}}
  max_players: 500
  tab_size: 60
  force_default_server: false
  proxy_protocol: false
  online_mode: {{ONLINE_MODE}}
servers:
  lobby:
    motd: 'lobby'
    address: 127.0.0.1:25566
    restricted: false
